A '''[[Gender/Legends|woman]]''' living during the [[Galactic War]] was the wife of [[Minister of Intelligence (Galactic War)|the man]] holding the rank of [[Keeper (Imperial Intelligence)|Keeper]] in the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]]. After he was promoted to the post of the [[Minister of Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Minister of Intelligence]], she openly approved of his new position. She occasionally complained that her husband would rather manipulate her than trust her judgment.<ref name="Forfeit">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=class|Imperial Agent|Forfeit|Rishi}}</ref>
